summary: All five High and seven Medium findings are accepted for remediation. None requires changing Pytincture's class-level BFF decorator contract or making Redis, process-memory sessions, or sticky routing mandatory.

findings.title: Automatic assistant-message DOM XSS
findings.disposition: remediate in dhxpyt and pin the complete patched wheel in Pytincture
findings.compatibility_note: Artifact titles and identifiers will render as text; applications relying on raw HTML there must use an explicit trusted rich-content path. Normal chat and BFF use is unchanged.

findings.title: Artifact preview escapes iframe isolation
findings.disposition: isolate untrusted previews and disable automatic model-supplied Python execution
findings.compatibility_note: Same-origin interactive scripts, parent-DOM access, and automatic Python execution will no longer work. Plain text, code, and passive media previews remain supported.

findings.title: Ordinary widget data reaches HTML sinks
findings.disposition: treat ordinary values as text and separate explicit sanitized rich-content APIs
findings.compatibility_note: Markup inserted as ordinary Grid, Listbox, CardFlow, or CardPanel data will be escaped. Trusted templates remain an explicit API.

findings.title: Encrypted SAML assertion bypasses transform preflight
findings.disposition: reject encrypted assertions until transform validation is guaranteed before xmlsec signature processing
findings.compatibility_note: Deployments using encrypted assertions must temporarily configure signed plaintext assertions. Other authentication methods, sessions, and BFFs are unchanged.

findings.title: Pickle IPC defeats isolated BFF process boundary
findings.disposition: replace pickle with bounded non-executable byte messages
findings.compatibility_note: Supported JSON-compatible BFF results remain unchanged; arbitrary pickled results were never part of the public contract.

findings.title: Timed-out synchronous streams leave orphan threads
findings.disposition: keep work admitted until completion or run it in a bounded killable executor
findings.compatibility_note: Indefinitely blocking synchronous iterators may be rejected or terminated; finite iterators and cooperative async streams remain supported.

findings.title: Public wheel requests repeatedly hash entire files
findings.disposition: cache verified digests, bound wheel size and admission, and support conditional requests
findings.compatibility_note: Only wheels above the documented safe size limit require a deployment override; normal backend wheel fallback remains unchanged.

findings.title: Weak artifact messaging and unbounded plaintext chat persistence
findings.compatibility_note: Oversized histories and logs will be truncated or evicted, and direct postMessage integrations must use the bound preview channel.

findings.title: Synchronous BFF transport and replay refill races
findings.disposition: add deadline-bounded async transport and single-flight refills without masking completed mutations
findings.compatibility_note: An async migration may require awaiting generated calls. The synchronous API will receive a documented compatibility/deprecation path rather than disappearing silently.

findings.title: Proxy example and edge auditor can certify spoofable forwarding
findings.disposition: replace forwarded client IPs and audit/probe the exact target vhost
findings.compatibility_note: Unsafe proxy configurations that previously passed qualification will fail until corrected; application behavior and correctly configured proxies are unchanged.

findings.title: Release validation ignores tar links and special members
findings.disposition: reject every non-directory and non-regular archive member
findings.compatibility_note: Normal Pytincture artifacts are unaffected; nonstandard custom archives containing links or special members fail closed.

findings.title: Dependency and repository integrity gaps
findings.disposition: require secret scan, whole-wheel verification, explicit external-runtime trust, lifecycle minimization, and independent clean rebuilds
findings.compatibility_note: Custom widget wheels or external Pyodide deployments may need administrator hashes or explicit development trust opt-in; runtime BFF APIs remain unchanged.
